 Order

1. This is second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS in connection with FIR/Crime No.609/2024, registered at Police Station-Jhabua, District- Jhabua, for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 506, 376(D), 376(3) 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5(l),6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 06.06.2024.

First bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 16.7.2024, passed in MCRC No. 27457/2024.
2. Allegation against the applicant is of commission of rape with one of the two victims.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.

Prosecutrix who has been alleged to be raped by the present applicant is 17 years old and her statement has been recorded before the trial Court, wherein she has not supported the prosecution case and turned hostile.
Even the parents of the prosecutrix have not supported the prosecution case and declared hostile.
Applicant is in custody since 06.06.2024 NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:3042 2 MCRC-4379-2025 (approximately 8 months).
Therefore, it is prayed that the application be allowed and the applicant be released on bail.
4. Counsel for the respondent/State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, statement of the prosecutrix and her parents, so also the custody period of the applicant, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this bail application filed on behalf of the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant/accused be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand only) with One solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial Court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3)
of the BNSS, 2023.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
